facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; the rial is convertible and capital moves without restriction.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks offer personal accounts in USD, GBP, EUR and more.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register with the Ministry of Commerce (MOCIIP); steps not confirmed yet.
facts.L2_tax_id: No personal tax, so TINs are for businesses (VAT, corporate tax).
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: No personal income tax until 2028; then 5% above OMR 42,000.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 5% VAT above OMR 38,500 turnover a year.
facts.L5_data_protection: A data protection law exists; details not confirmed yet.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.

watch_out.text: From 2028, residents pay 5% on worldwide income above OMR 42,000.
